channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Voices: Paid leave gave my little family a chance. All Utahns deserve that chance.
item.description: “We tell young people that if they do everything right, they can make it work,” writes Jennifer Stout in an op-ed. “Paid family leave is how we actually make it work — for children, for parents and for Utah families.”

item.title: A major Cache County employer is set to expand its dairy production plant. Here’s why it likely won’t help local farmers.
item.description: Here's what experts say will likely happen to Cache Valley's dairy industry when a major dairy plant in Logan expands.

item.title: LDS Church-backed A.I. bill would make it easier to sue over damaging ‘deepfakes’
item.description: The LDS Church is backing a bill that would make it easier to sue those who use AI to create “deepfake” images that harm an individual’s reputation.

item.title: Know how to defend NBA MVP Nikola Jokic? ‘Email me,’ Utah Jazz coach says.
item.description: Head coach Will Hardy turned to an unconventional option to defend Denver’s Nikola Jokic in Monday’s game against Denver.

item.title: ‘Your kid is gone’: How Utah adoption laws can cost fathers their parental rights
item.description: He planned to be at the hospital when his daughter was born. Instead, he got an email saying she had been placed for adoption. His case sheds light on Utah’s strict — and largely unknown — putative father registry.

item.title: Beware of increasing deception from A.I., Latter-day Saint apostle advises BYU students
item.description: Apostle Quentin Cook counsels BYU students and Latter-day Saints about the dangers of artificial intelligence. Let technology be "a servant," he said, "not a master."

item.title: ‘Irresponsible’ to tie Trump’s hands in Iran, Rep. Blake Moore says of war powers
item.description: The six members of Utah’s federal delegation have so far remained largely silent on President Donald Trump’s authority to continue military operations in Iran.

item.title: BYU basketball has earned a commit from yet another 5-star recruit. Here’s who is coming to Provo next.
item.description: Bruce Branch III is rated as the No. 8 prospect in the 2026 recruiting class.

item.title: Best pizza in Utah? Here’s how you can help pick.
item.description: Pizza Madness, The Salt Lake Tribune's bracket-style tournament, is happening now. Here's how to vote.

item.title: Why Utah Utes’ President Taylor Randall plans to meet with Donald Trump this week
item.description: University of Utah President Taylor Randall is scheduled to meet with President Donald Trump this week to discuss the future of college athletics.
